f2670d8ab541d167f0e354a6dc2aaebe4d1f9529.summary: A Linux how-to guide on scheduling one-time jobs with the at command: entering times, listing and removing queued jobs, controlling user access, and the batch command. It is administrative documentation, not a threat report, so no threat actors, malware, vulnerabilities or incidents are described.

f23f9a480c5cdd7c79dd78ef6536520d24cf0551.summary: CrowdStrike researchers describe Sprite Spider, a ransomware threat actor they tied to the DEFRAY777 ransomware and to earlier tools Shifu, Vatet and PyXie. The group started with Shifu in 2015 and began targeting VMware ESXi hosts in July 2020. The article also covers other ransomware groups (Wizard Spider, Indrik Spider, Carbon Spider), the link between commodity malware and ransomware, comments on nation-state involvement, and defence advice from CrowdStrike's Adam Meyers.

f260bc5667c5378141a6ba8199d930d6224b9d31.summary: Synacktiv CSIRT analysis of LinkPro, a Golang Linux rootkit found in an AWS EKS environment. Initial access came via an exposed, vulnerable Jenkins server. Two eBPF modules hide the backdoor and activate it on a magic packet. Passive (reverse) and active (forward) modes are described. The infection chain used a malicious container image with a host mount, a vGet downloader loading vShell in memory, and a dropper using DNS tunneling. No formal threat actor attribution was made; objectives appear financial.
